Ishqa’n De Lekhe — the title track of Ishqa'n De Lekhe in the soulful voice of Sajjan Adeeb, starring Gurnam Bhullar and Isha Malviya.
A melody woven with love, destiny, and deep emotions, this title song beautifully captures the essence of heartfelt romance.
